marker_reviews.reason: This dynamic SELECT is the pre-drop emptiness refusal for the two obsolete ColdLion history tables. It writes nothing and deliberately has no durable verification target: if either table contains a row, the migration raises and stops before either DROP TABLE can execute.

These three dynamic statements only set access posture on the ColdLion landing tables: enable row level security, revoke every privilege from public, anon and authenticated, and grant to service_role. They insert, update and delete nothing, so there is no row, key or catalog value a typed row-count check could read back. The posture they produce is asserted instead by the repository contract tests coldlion_order_history_contracts.sql, coldlion_history_page_ledger_contracts.sql and coldlion_raw_landing_phases_2_6_contracts.sql, which fail if any ColdLion landing table lacks row security or carries an application-role grant.
